dedupe_keys.name: superwell geo processed global aquifer properties zenodo release

description: This Superwell input collection from Pacific Northwest National Laboratory harmonizes global aquifer properties at 0.5-degree resolution. The verified Zenodo release contains aquifer class, porosity, permeability, aquifer thickness, depth to groundwater and grid area, together with country and basin identifiers. It provides a consolidated CSV table, geospatial source layers, R processing scripts and smaller sampled inputs. These data can support groundwater-availability estimates or prepare hydro-economic simulations of drinking-water and irrigation supply. It is a static compilation of published sources with different reference periods, not a uniform groundwater-monitoring time series. The versioned files are openly downloadable and free under CC BY 4.0. A limitation is uncertainty inherited from the source maps and aggregation to coarse cells. The later MSD-LIVE input release cited in GMD also describes recharge and lake fields; those additions are not asserted for this earlier verified Zenodo release. Superwell is a separate G5 model draft, and no directly related existing catalogue record was established. The data archives were not downloaded.
